blocks.text: Is chapter ke aakhir tak students yeh kar sakenge:

items: Computational thinking ke mukhtalif tareeqon se aasan aur mushkil dono tarah ke masail (problems) hal karna: masle ko pehchanna (identify), chhote hisson mein torna (break down) aur us ka hal (solution) banana. Phir apne hal ki jaanch (evaluate) kar ke usay behtar (refine) karna, aur yun dikhana ke woh mukhtalif computational techniques samajhte hain.

Bunyadi computational artifacts (computer mein bani cheezein, jaise programs) aur algorithms (qadam ba qadam hidayat) ka amli istemal samajhna. Is mein masla hal karne ke aam computational tareeqe samjhana, aur saada computational structures (data rakhne ke dhaanche) jaise lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs ki bunyadi samajh shamil hai. Is ke ilawa students knowledge representation (ilm ko computer ke liye likhna) aur reasoning (daleel se nateeja nikalna) istemal kar sakenge, aur masle hal karne mein propositional aur predicate logic se kaam le sakenge.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is chapter ke do bare hisse hain: (1) computational thinking, yani masle ko tor kar qadam ba qadam hal karna aur phir hal ko check kar ke behtar banana; (2) logic, yani sach aur jhoot ke qaidon se baatein likhna aur un se sahi nateeja nikalna.

Is chapter mein students logic (mantiq, yani sahi tarah sochne ke qaide) aur computational thinking ke bunyadi concepts seekhte hain jo computer science mein istemal hote hain. Woh samajhte hain ke masla (problem) saaf aur systematic (tarteeb wale) tareeqe se kaise hal kiya jata hai. Students computational thinking ki techniques dekhte hain, jaise decomposition (bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torna) aur step-by-step (qadam ba qadam) problem solving. Woh propositional logic, truth values (sach ya jhoot ki qeemat), truth tables aur logical equivalence (do baaton ka mantiqi taur par barabar hona) bhi parhte hain.

Chapter satisfiable aur unsatisfiable propositions bhi batata hai (yani aisi baat jo kabhi sach ho sakti hai, aur aisi jo kabhi sach nahi ho sakti) aur faisla karne mein in ka kirdar. Phir students predicate logic, variables aur quantifiers seekhte hain, jin se rishte (relationships) aur shartein (conditions) likhi jati hain. Aakhir mein woh logical reasoning (mantiqi soch) aur inference (diye gaye facts se nateeja nikalna) ki skills banate hain, jo analytical thinking (gehri soch) aur computer science ke aage ke topics ki mazboot bunyad hain.
